verdict.rationale: Moss is a semantic search runtime. Scheduled or background jobs, such as recurring re-crawls or index refreshes, are a plausible capability for this kind of product, so the axis applies. The evidence covers only one-off API, CLI and MCP actions (crawling a web source, upserting documents) and hot-swap freshness of loaded indexes. Nothing documents user-defined automations or recurring schedules that run autonomously in the background.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
